title: I FOLLOW THROUGH ON WHAT I COMMIT TO
note: Not released. Song: I Follow Through on What I Commit To (3:30, Arabesque electronic, 124 BPM), Suno take 13eb52cb. Over 3:00: the vertical cut needs --cut3m-start. Covers: make in ChatGPT from the FREQ 001 cover, lines I FOLLOW|THROUGH. Calendar: freq/CALENDAR.md.
alt_text: A gold frequency ring glows around the NDCH arch-and-Y emblem on black stone veined with gold, under the title I FOLLOW THROUGH ON WHAT I COMMIT TO, NDCH FREQ 007. The picture pushes in slowly and the gold breathes brighter while one line repeats: I follow through on what I commit to.

location.name: Brooklyn Bridge
location.why: When its engineer could no longer go to the site, Emily Warren Roebling carried the work for over a decade and saw it finished. Week two of the year, when most resolutions quietly stop.
